name: modrix/contact-form
description: A contact form block for any page, an inbox in the admin, and an optional email for every new message.
author: Modrix

settings.name: recipient
settings.label: Email new messages to
settings.help: Leave empty to only keep them in Admin → Messages. Needs SMTP set up in Settings.

settings.name: success_message
settings.label: Thank-you message
settings.default: Thanks! Your message is on its way. We'll get back to you soon.
